articles.description:
I've been in this field for 10+ years, and have seen all the transitions and break throughs at different points of time. From the first time using the internet as a 90s kid to having to adapt to a cloud world, I've seen it all. I've built multiple services with Ruby on Rails, Java stack, React, AWS/Azure, you name it. I'm in Big Tech, and my path was set. But now, I'm stumped. Its AI everywhere, and it has taken over. Within my own org, I feel useless as I use Cline and other tools to migrate a service that would have taken at least 3 month, to just within 2 weeks. Despite delivering (just typing what I wanted it to do), I had mixed feelings. I was not sure if I have to be happy about the outcome or just sad about the inevitability. All over social media, its about AI will not replace anyone but only the ones that don't use AI. Well, I don't believe that. It's already here and has outsource Intelligence. I'm never going to be better than it. That's the reality.
But What can I do? All I can do is the best I can do. I have come up with a plan, and I'm sticking with it. To study everything I can, to transition from a software engineer to being an AI engineer.
PS: Didn't mean it be negative, but this is what I feel.
articles.title: From Software Engineer to AI Engineer

“Security is not a feature. It is a discipline.” - Laravel Community
Defense in Depth: Laravel provides multiple built-in security layers (CSRF, hashing, validation, ORM protection) that work best when used together.
OWASP Alignment: Most Laravel security features directly mitigate OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities such as SQL Injection, XSS, and CSRF.
Secure by Default: Laravel’s opinionated defaults (bcrypt/argon hashing, prepared statements, CSRF middleware) dramatically reduce attack surfaces.
Authentication Hardening: Proper use of guards, rate limiting, and password policies prevents brute-force and credential stuffing attacks.
Configuration Matters: Many security breaches occur not due to framework flaws, but because of misconfigured environments, permissions, or exposed secrets.

The best part? Running add auth automatically installs

Drizzle ORM → type-safe queries, no heavy binary, 
Better-Auth → modern, actively maintained, works 
Zod → runtime + TypeScript validation in one shot
Pino → literally the fastest JSON logger for Node.js
Helmet → secure HTTP headers with zero config
Honestly? I built this for myself first.
I'm a student from India who builds a lot of hackathon 
Zuro CLI is for:
Students starting backend projects
Hackathon builders who need to ship fast
Developers tired of copy-pasting the same setup
There's a lot more coming. More modules, more options,

npx zuro-cli init my-app
Docs → https://zuro-cli.devbybriyan.com
It's completely free and open source.
